hardestReference.where: articles.json "Mediterranean diet (anti-inflammatory)" / What the evidence says

hardestReference.where: articles.json "Low added sugar" / What the evidence says

hardestReference.sentence: The governing sources are the AGA-ACG clinical practice guideline on chronic idiopathic constipation (Chang et al., Gastroenterology 2023), the multicenter randomized trial of green kiwifruit (Gearry et al., American Journal of Gastroenterology 2023), the Bharucha and Lacy review of mechanisms and management (Gastroenterology 2020), and the Institute of Medicine's Dietary Reference Intakes for fiber.

hardestReference.where: articles.json "Rheumatoid arthritis" / What the evidence says
hardestReference.sentence: The governing sources are the 2022 American College of Rheumatology guideline on exercise, rehabilitation, diet, and integrative interventions for RA (England et al., Arthritis Care and Research 2023), the 2021 EULAR lifestyle recommendations for rheumatic diseases (Gwinnutt et al., Annals of the Rheumatic Diseases 2023), and the PREDIMED trial for the general cardiovascular case for Mediterranean eating.

hardestReference.where: articles.json "Celiac disease" / What the evidence says
hardestReference.sentence: The governing sources are the American College of Gastroenterology clinical guideline on diagnosis and management of celiac disease (Rubio-Tapia et al., 2023), the Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics celiac evidence-based practice guideline, the FDA gluten-free labeling rule (21 CFR 101.91), and patient materials from the Celiac Disease Foundation and Beyond Celiac for practical food lists.
